title: mcp-grafana X-Grafana-URL header server-side request forgery (CVE-2026-19516)
summary: mcp-grafana before 1.1.0 honors a caller-supplied X-Grafana-URL request header that controls the destination of the server's outbound requests, and the grafana_api_request tool additionally lets the caller choose the HTTP method, path, and body. Because the destination is not restricted to the configured Grafana instance, a caller can direct requests at internal, loopback, and link-local network services (including cloud metadata endpoints) and read the responses, resulting in server-side request forgery. The earlier fix for CVE-2026-15583 prevented the configured service-account token from being sent to unintended destinations but did not restrict the destinations themselves. Fixed in 1.1.0, which removes support for the undocumented X-Grafana-URL header (grafana/mcp-grafana#1052).
